def solve_problem():

    m = Model("Optimization_Problem")

    # 2. Variables
    vars = {}
    lin_expr = 0
    vars['Var_0'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=6.72, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_0')
    lin_expr += 5.38 * vars['Var_0']
    vars['Var_1'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=7.54, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_1')
    lin_expr += 3.39 * vars['Var_1']
    vars['Var_2'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=12.42, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_2')
    lin_expr += 8.44 * vars['Var_2']
    vars['Var_3'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=14.95, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_3')
    lin_expr += 4.66 * vars['Var_3']
    vars['Var_4'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=13.99, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_4')
    lin_expr += 4.07 * vars['Var_4']
    vars['Var_5'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=12.29, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_5')
    lin_expr += 6.69 * vars['Var_5']
    vars['Var_6'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=18.34, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_6')
    lin_expr += 9.77 * vars['Var_6']
    vars['Var_7'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=11.59, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_7')
    lin_expr += 5.34 * vars['Var_7']
    vars['Var_8'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=19.22, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_8')
    lin_expr += 4.61 * vars['Var_8']

    m.setObjective(lin_expr, GRB.MAXIMIZE)

    # 3. Constraints
    m.addConstr(6.16 * vars['Var_0'] + -7.59 * vars['Var_2'] + 1.89 * vars['Var_8'] <= 13.41, name='C0')
    m.addConstr(-5.04 * vars['Var_3'] + 5.71 * vars['Var_5'] + 5.48 * vars['Var_6'] + -3.32 * vars['Var_8'] <= 16.2, name='C1')
    m.addConstr(7.2 * vars['Var_0'] + -9.07 * vars['Var_6'] + -1.1 * vars['Var_7'] <= -22.73, name='C2')
    m.addConstr(4.93 * vars['Var_2'] + 7.61 * vars['Var_6'] + 2.79 * vars['Var_7'] <= 81.11, name='C3')
    m.addConstr(7.68 * vars['Var_2'] <= 33.18, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(-4.24 * vars['Var_0'] + 9.29 * vars['Var_3'] + -4.34 * vars['Var_6'] + -9.1 * vars['Var_7'] <= -27.5, name='C5')
    m.addConstr(4.82 * vars['Var_0'] + 6.37 * vars['Var_5'] + -5.52 * vars['Var_8'] <= 33.95, name='C6')
    m.addConstr(8.41 * vars['Var_4'] + 6.13 * vars['Var_6'] <= 80.97, name='C7')
    m.addConstr(6.3 * vars['Var_0'] + -6.91 * vars['Var_3'] + -7.65 * vars['Var_4'] <= -67.66, name='C8')
    m.addConstr(-2.23 * vars['Var_4'] + -5.55 * vars['Var_7'] + -3.21 * vars['Var_8'] <= -72.78, name='C9')

    # 4. Optimize
    m.optimize()
    return m
